subject: a cauliflower-like satellite head made from prism clusters
pose: cluster tilted with two short antennae angled inward
art_direction: 花椰菜般的几何卫星头由半透明棱块组成，短天线与橙色中心眼赋予奇特机械植物性格。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Invent a compact satellite head whose shape resembles a cauliflower built from translucent mint and periwinkle prism clusters. A single small amber lens sits in the center, functioning as a calm curious eye without becoming a realistic eyeball. Two short antennae angle inward above the cluster, and a simple dark neck socket supports it. Render the glass-like prism depth and internal reflections carefully, keeping the outer lobes large enough to read as a coherent head. Use a deep slate-blue background and one warm edge light. The object fills the central seventy-five percent of the square, with no space panorama, technical lettering, wires, or additional machinery outside the circular crop.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
